content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to share information such as I/O status or function block statuses between two [product_name] [article_no]? I came across the [product_name] communication module for EIB/KNX, but I'm not entirely sure how to proceed. Thanks for any advice.

Hi [user_name], Yes, direct communication between two [product_name] modules is only feasible using the EIB/KNX communication module. However, you'll also need specific configuration software from the KNX association (refer to [url]), which can also be purchased through [company_name]. Alternatively, communication can be achieved using ASI, but this requires an ASI Master—for example, a [product_name] PLC with an ASI communication processor. Generally, these [product_name] modules aren't preferred for communication purposes due to higher costs and complexity compared to more streamlined PLC solutions. Using two standard PLCs (such as [product_name] models) may be more cost-effective and convenient, as they only require one software package and provide a simpler setup. Of course, the optimal solution depends on your specific application!
